svg.title: Factors 5 to 8. The model proposes a refund of 1,200 dollars. Your loop, not the prompt, checks the rule with an if statement: is the amount over 1,000 dollars (factor 8)? If not, the refund is issued. If so, the agent calls ask_human to get a manager's approval (factor 7), then saves and pauses with status waiting (factor 6). When the manager approves, the run resumes and issues the refund. Underneath it all is one saved record holding both where the run is and the real data (factor 5).
